watch.summary: The streamer shares sincere, emotional praise for 100 Thieves after watching their journey through tough times to a big victory.

beats.what: Streamer reflects on 100 Thieves grinding through the lowest of lows.
He states how happy he is for them despite respecting other teams.
Streamer admits he is feeling genuinely emotional watching them win.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'm out here feeling emotional just hearing them talk.
watch.why: This is a wholesome, earnest reaction moment praising an esports team's journey. It is meant to be heartfelt rather than comedic.
